Method of Attack: Installs Node.JS onto victim machines and configures it as a proxy server for click-fraud and other malicious activity
Executes a PowerShell script that disables Windows Defender and modifies Windows Update settings
Adds Windows policies to disable various Windows Defender functionalities including real-time protection and automatic malware removal
Indicators of Compromise: Registry keys modifying Windows Defender policies such as DisableAntiSpyware, DisableRoutinelyTakingAction, DisableRealtimeMonitoring
Registry keys modifying Windows Update settings such as NoAutoUpdate, AUOptions, ScheduledInstallDay, ScheduledInstallTime
Disabling peer-to-peer Windows updates via DeliveryOptimization DODownloadMode
